purpose: Make the active Song contain real durable material instead of title/session metadata only: let the artist add one local file through the normal Song surface, preserve an immutable verified local copy inside the active Artist profile, attach it to canonical Asset lineage, create a new current Version parented to the prior current Version, and show current/approved/material continuity after navigation and Quit/relaunch.

lineage.outcome: An artist can bring an actual local demo, mix, MIDI file or other Song material into the active Song and return later to the same verified bytes and current Version without N0TE confusing imported/current with approved.
lineage.capability: Local immutable Song material ingest plus canonical Asset/Version continuity on the normal Song surface

why_now: DAW-00A-G now provide enough shared workspace truth that continuing the chassis by adjacency would underweight the customer journey. The live Song surface still contains only Song/session text even though CORE-01 already has immutable Asset identity and current/approved Version lineage. The concrete missing seam is safe local byte ownership plus consumer ingestion into that existing lineage.
instead_of: Another DAW-00 chassis increment is not selected because A-G now provide host/workspace/focus/shadow/reconciliation/capability/observation foundations and this customer-visible Song gap is construction-ready without host-specific work.
Workspaces/Health UI is not selected because it still depends on real adapter observations for meaningful environment content; Song material ingest provides immediate value with no connected DAW.
Template/suggestion/randomize is not selected because its persisted catalog/distance/lock/suppression model remains absent.
OPS-04 communications is dependency-ready but does not improve the immediate make/resume Song outcome as directly as preserving the actual work itself.
Audio analysis/derivation is not selected because N0TE must first possess and lineage the source material truthfully before deriving musical claims from it.

n0te2_dependencies: UX/SONG consumer shell one-shot CSRF/local-only action contract
legacy_rejections: external path reference treated as durable ownership
upload form that records metadata without preserving bytes
browser-selected filename trusted as filesystem path
audio analysis presented as part of ingest

completion_proof: the normal /song path lets the artist add one local file to the exact active Song without connecting a DAW, AI model, provider or account
upload authority is bound to one server-side one-shot action and exact active Song; foreign Origin, wrong CSRF, replay and active-Song change fail closed before lineage creation
input size is explicitly bounded and empty, malformed or oversized material is rejected without creating an Asset or Version
the browser filename is reduced to a safe display basename and never controls a destination path

bytes are streamed to a profile-scoped staging file while SHA-256 is computed, fsynced, installed under a content-addressed immutable managed-material path and verified before canonical lineage references them
existing identical bytes may reuse one managed blob without changing its content; Song Asset identity/history remains explicit rather than silently merging unrelated Song lineage
the canonical Asset stores the verified digest and a managed local source URI; current Version is created with the prior current Version as parent and the imported Asset attached
importing material never changes approved_version_id; current and approved remain visibly distinct
the Song surface shows the current Version and its material names using artist-readable copy without raw asset/version/profile IDs or filesystem paths

Quit/relaunch preserves the active Song, current Version, material lineage and managed bytes; a missing or tampered managed blob is reported as a protected integrity problem rather than silently trusted
multiple Artist profiles and Songs remain isolated; one profile/Song cannot resolve another profile's managed material
ingest performs no audio analysis, generation, provider egress, DAW mutation, publication, approval or paid action
authored HTTP/invariant/restart proof remains separate from executed evidence; absent hosted execution is UNOBSERVED
next_selection_rule: After SONG-01C lands or blocks, globally reselect. Compare version/asset history/approval reachability, remaining SONG-01 creative continuity, Workspaces/Health, DAW mutation/IR/portability chassis, AUDIO and OPS-04. Do not automatically continue to SONG-01D or audio analysis.
